review.evidence: At Ethereum block 26197390 (hash 0x7b440503cf5ab984190e71b6363dc024da6e6944ed5cf22073f6eca2a26092de; timestamp 2026-10-15T10:43:11Z), owner is the listed 4-of-7 Safe and curator the listed 3-of-6 Safe, sharing six signer addresses. Both have no enabled modules, terminal pagination 0x1, zero guards and the recorded fallback handler; no signer independence, key-custody or exhaustive fallback execution certificate is inferred. All three published allocators and the one sentinel were individually reconfirmed; no extra role is inferred from a failed read. Complete published selector census, independently pinned with timelock(bytes4)/abdicated(bytes4): addAdapter, removeAdapter, increaseTimelock and abdicate have 604800-second delays; increaseAbsoluteCap, increaseRelativeCap and setSendAssetsGate have 259200-second delays; setIsAllocator, setReceiveSharesGate, setSendSharesGate, setReceiveAssetsGate, setAdapterRegistry, decreaseTimelock, setPerformanceFee, setManagementFee, both fee-recipient setters and setForceDeallocatePenalty have zero stored delays. The three share/withdrawal gate setters and setAdapterRegistry are abdicated; other enumerated selectors are not. decreaseTimelock inherits the affected selector's delay in code, not its own zero mapping value. Performance fee=50000000000000000 WAD (5%), management fee=0, force-deallocation penalty=0, maxRate=63419583967 per second. The adapter burnShares delay is 259200 seconds, abdicate delay 604800, and skim-recipient/increase/decrease-timelock mapping delays zero; these adapter selectors are not abdicated. Current adapter and all three collateral IDs have uint128-max absolute caps and 100% relative caps; market absolute caps are 60000000000000, 40000000000000 and 10000000000000 atomic USDC respectively for reUSD, sUSDS and sUSDE, each with a 100% relative cap. These are allocation bounds, not a hard supply cap. Reconciliation remains not-applicable for local deposit/fee-share issuance; supervision remains none and framework code audits are not financial assurance. Historical functional compiler/runtime correspondence from 2026-10-03 at block 26107703 is retained, not represented as a new compilation: VaultV2 reference Sourcify chain 8453 0x91c056b6d4311a743614fbc03ac32d4e6a2d3a3c, runtimeMatch=match, matchId 30034094, verifiedAt 2026-05-26T22:26:25Z, solc 0.8.28+commit.7893614a, viaIR, optimizer 100000. Runtime length=21808 bytes; masks were only declared immutable AST37 asset (6), AST39 decimals (1), AST41 virtualShares (5), and 12-byte CBOR auxdata at offset 21796. All twelve immutable occurrences matched asset=0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48, decimals=18, virtualShares=1000000000000; all remaining executable bytes matched, normalized SHA-256=cf17ab0161388ea9277000e692e929216da2618e441c54bcd677def1000dd12e. Adapter reference Sourcify chain 8453 0x812b71c33ae5eafebae967c5670e37eca3cab0ac, runtimeMatch=match, matchId 33231859, verifiedAt 2026-06-21T06:48:43Z, same compiler/viaIR/optimizer. Runtime length=11784 bytes; masks were declared immutable AST2265 factory (1), AST2267 parentVault (6), AST2269 asset (3), AST2271 morpho (4), AST2273 adapterId (2), AST2275 adaptiveCurveIrm (4), plus 12-byte CBOR auxdata at offset 11772. All twenty immutable occurrences matched factory=0x32bb1c0d48d8b1b3363e86eeb9a0300bad61ccc1, parentVault=0x55c1b6e461a6334b567baf0feb5d728715446f05, asset=USDC, morpho=0xbbbbbbbbbb9cc5e90e3b3af64bdaf62c37eeffcb, adapterId=0xfedec349ee09b28220002495ffdd04bc287f1e59751e5828c24e4d075e746732, adaptiveCurveIrm=0x870ac11d48b15db9a138cf899d20f13f79ba00bc; all remaining executable bytes matched, normalized SHA-256=355d973d7a246e5d4c02bb68e7415b9d62bf584a57f6101357b57c5d2fc40113.
